At Bullers Wood School, we endeavour to combine our students’ formal education with a personalised, independent and informed career guidance, which will enable them to embark on their future with the skills to build upon their career pathways. Our careers programme aligns with the 8 Gatsby Benchmarks to provide high quality career education and guidance to our students.
If you have any queries, please contact the Careers and Work-related Co-ordinator at lrichardson@bwsgirls.org.

If you wish to book a meeting with our Careers advisor, please contact the Careers and Work-Related Learning Co-ordinator at lrichardson@bwsgirls.org
During your time at Bullers Wood School, you will have the chance to meet industry professionals and learn about different careers through a vast range of activities that we provide.
In line with the Gatsby Benchmarks, at Bullers we offer the following to each year groups:

pageCache.pageTitle: Bullers School for Girls - Sixth Form Courses and Entrance Requirements
pageCache.text:
Sixth Form Courses and Entrance Requirements
Most students will study three subjects, with the possibility of a fourth option such as the Extended Project Qualification, or in some cases a fourth A Level subject. Certain combinations of subjects may not be possible, although we do our best to accommodate requests. All courses are offered subject to staffing and student numbers.
All Level 3 courses will allow you to gain a place at university. There are three different pathways to choose from:
A Levels are our more academic courses, while BTECs and other vocational courses are work-related qualifications for learners taking their first steps into employment or planning to enter university. The world’s most successful, best-loved applied learning brand, BTEC has been engaging learners in practical, interpersonal and thinking skills for over 30 years.
It is important that you select courses which are appropriate for your personal needs and ability. Please check the entry requirements below when selecting your courses.
If you wish to go to university after school, for more information, see the Russell Group’s Informed Choices website

pageCache.pageTitle: Bullers School for Girls - The Careers Programme at Bullers Wood School
pageCache.text:
The Careers Programme at Bullers Wood School
We endeavour to combine our students’ formal education with a personalised, independent, and informed career guidance, which will enable them to embark on their future with the skills to build upon their career pathways. Our careers programme aligns with the 8 Gatsby Benchmarks to provide high quality career education and guidance to our students.
The activities will support all students to:
As of 2015, young people are required to stay in education until the age of 18. They are not required to stay in School, instead they can choose how they wish to participate within education. This can be through:
Each student will have the opportunity for a personalised one-to-one careers interview with Kirsty Taylor, our Independent Careers Guidance Advisor. This will allow them to explore the full spectrum of post-16 pathways. They will also benefit from employer interactions through assemblies and Careers Week events.
Work Related Learning
The school aims to offer all students the opportunity to experience work-related learning from year 7 to year 13 through a wide range of subjects including specific work-experience and employer contact.
All teachers link curriculum learning with careers.
The three main ways we deliver careers in the curriculum are:
All subject teachers emphasise the importance of succeeding in English and maths. Science subject teachers highlight the relevance of science for a wide range of future career paths.
Throughout the year various industry experts will be invited in to give career insights, this will include areas such as engineering, medical, veterinarian, health, and beauty.
Evaluation and Measures
The school records destination information for Year 11 and Year 13 and adapts the career programme to reflect the changing trends.
We complete the Compass evaluation and are using this to drive improvement. We update our careers programmes to reflect current labour market information and renew the programmes yearly to remain current.
Students and staff complete yearly evaluations of the careers programmes and this is used to adapt and maintain the programme.

pageCache.pageTitle: Bullers School for Girls - Friends of Bullers Wood
pageCache.text:
Friends of Bullers Wood
We would like to say a huge thank you to parents, carers, staff, pupils and all of our school community for helping us with our fundraising efforts this year.
Whether it has been through a monthly contribution, one off donations, attending an event or volunteering for one of our fundraisers, we appreciate you getting involved and helping to raise much needed funds for our pupils.
It is a difficult time for everyone in this financial crisis, and the money we raise is put to good use around the school where it is needed.
Around two thirds of our fundraising each year comes from the monthly contribution scheme donations and the gift aid that they provide. These monthly donations are essential for us to be able to continue to support the school and our pupils. If you do not already have one set up, please consider donating through this scheme, you can do so in a few moments by following the link below.
Veronica Huxtable – Chair
Victoria Virtue-Boussie – Vice Chair
The Team & You
Our volunteers are a friendly and enthusiastic group, and everyone brings really diverse skills to support with our fundraising. We appreciate every second of time and effort already put in to make each event a success. We are always on the look out for more help, ideas, and people to support us in fundraising for our wonderful school. Our simple goal is to enrich the lives and learning experiences of every young person at Bullers’ Wood. If you can spare any time, or have a great idea you’d like to discuss with the team, please reach out to please reach out to:
All can be contacted via the Friends’ mailbox: friendsofbullerswoodgirls@gmail.com
Chair – Veronica Huxtable
Vice Chair – Victoria Virtue-Boussie
Secretary – Sophie Mercer
Treasurer – Mike O’Connor and Liz Kirby
Bids Officer – Peter Taylor
What else can I do?
If you have time to do three things, our students would be so grateful if you could:
1) Join the Covenant Scheme – Donation Form
The Covenant Scheme is a particularly effective way of fundraising for us as taxpayers’ donations are supplemented with an additional 25% Gift Aid. The amount you donate is totally up to you, but £20 per month is a suggested contribution. For less than the cost of a weekly takeout coffee and sandwich, these monthly donations are crucial to enabling us to budget for our big-ticket items – like the outdoor classroom and refurbished gym.
2) Volunteer for at least ONE event by emailing Sam Davis, our Events Co-ordinator, via the Friends’ mailbox.
3) Round up to the closest £5.00 next time you buy something through School Gateway so that any extra pennies go straight to the Friends.
I can still do more…
If you are able to support us even more, we’d HUGELY appreciate it if you would:
4) Buy a ticket for a school event – from a raffle ticket to a table at quiz night.
5) Make a donation to an event – we will happily receive all donations for a hamper or a raffle prize.
6) Come to one of our meetings or sign up to Easy Fundraising and choose Bullers Wood School for girls as your chosen charity – Create an account | easyfundraising
7) Set aside clothes for Bag2School collections or donate old school uniform for our pre-loved Uniform Sale
8) Read our Sponsorship Letter and have a think about whether you own or work for a company that could provide sponsorship or services to our school – Sponsorship Letter
9) Your School Lottery https://www.yourschoollottery.co.uk/lottery/school/bullers-wood-school-for-girls
For any further information, or to talk to someone in the team about how you can get involved, please reach out to Veronica Huxtable (Chair) or Victoria Virtue-Boussie (Vice Chair) at friendsofbullerswoodgirls@gmail.com
